jobs.description: Job Responsibilities Deploy, configure, update, and maintain software applications and services on Linux-based robotic devices. Basic understanding of TCP/IP, SSH, and Linux networking. Good problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively with R&D teams. Chinese and English are the working languages; good working proficiency in both is required. Preferred Qualifications Experience with robotic systems, embedded Linux, or other smart devices. Familiarity with OTA updates, remote device management, or software version control. Basic knowledge of DDS, ROS2, Docker, or CI/CD tools. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. jobs.description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role As a Social Manager you will own our social channels and bring the work we do to the audiences who need to understand it: military personnel, procurement professionals, policymakers and defence commentators. This is a hands-on role with full ownership, from channel strategy and the publishing calendar to creating content, engaging our audiences and measuring performance. You’ll plan ahead while making daily editorial decisions about what to say, where to say it and when to hold back. You’ll work closely with our Video Editor, Art Director, product marketing, PR and government relations teams to bring their work together around launches, events and campaigns. Your aim is to reach the right people with credible, accurate content that builds awareness and contributes to the wider conversation about defence capability. What You Will Do Own UFORCE's social channels: strategy, calendar, publishing, community and performance. Decide the role of each platform, the audiences it serves and the content mix that reaches them. Plan a rolling quarterly calendar and hold a consistent weekly cadence. jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description: At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition. Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities. In this fully on-site position, you are the first person people come to with any IT issue, whether it’s a MacBook, a SaaS application, identity and access management, or hardware and AV. You support our growing Zug office and act as first- to third-line support. Our environment is predominantly macOS and cloud-based, with a small Windows footprint. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale.  Your Responsibilities: First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS. Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management). Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance. Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup. Installing, setting up and servicing hardware and peripherals, including laptops, monitors, printers, and audio and video conferencing systems. Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues. Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date. Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves. Everything else that keeps us moving. Your Skills and Experience A degree in an ICT-related field

Lead verification and validation: test plans, trials, acceptance tests and reports against requirements. Produce user documentation: user manuals, quick-start guides, and structured field feedback to R&D.
